title: fix(spec)!: the published list-query schemas declare the page window the Data API enforces
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6zwDuV2XvoDkqC7bXgqnpc)_

Fixes #25269

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The Data API list doors refuse a page window that is not a non-negative integer (PR #25260, one normalizer in `findData`). The published request schemas for those doors still declared any number, so a client generated from them was told `-1`, `1.5` or a blank `?top=` was valid. Now they declare what the door enforces, from one declaration.

- **One bound, exported by the spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`): `QueryPageWindowSchema` (`z.number().int().nonnegative()`, which in zod 4 is exactly `Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0`) and `QueryPageWindowParamSchema` (that number, or a non-blank string whose `Number(...)` is one, parsed to the count). Type aliases per ADR-0122.
- **The normalizer reads it** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `pageWindowValue`): the window is judged by `QueryPageWindowParamSchema.safeParse` instead of a restated predicate. `metadata-protocol` already imports the spec's transport tables from `@objectstack/spec/data`, so there is no layering inversion. Same accept set, same refusal text and code.
- **`FindDataRequestSchema`** (the `POST /data/:object/query` body, through `QueryWithTransportSchema`): the canonical `limit` / `offset` / `top` members declare the page window; the transport spellings `$top` / `$skip` / `skip` (`QueryTransportParamsSchema`) declare it on their number arm, and the fold's string lowering judges the digits by `QueryPageWindowParamSchema` (it used to accept any finite number). `QuerySchema` itself is not touched (see Measured).
- **`HttpFindQueryParamsSchema`** (the `GET /data/:object` querystring declaration): `top` / `skip` declare `QueryPageWindowParamSchema` instead of `z.coerce.number()`, which admitted `-1`, `1.5` and a blank value (as `0`).
- **Generated artifacts**: reference docs, `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `json-schema.manifest`, and two new rows in `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` (the string arm's refine has no JSON Schema form; its `Number` semantics cannot be written as a pattern without approximating it, so it is declared there as the ledger asks).

## Measured: which schemas a door actually reads (base `8dfd1265f`, re-checked after merging `bda53bb0b`)

The normalizer judges the top-level `limit` / `offset` of a `findData` call (`pageWindowValue`, two call sites). `findData` callers: `GET /data/:object` (querystring, no schema), `POST /data/:object/query` (validates `FindDataRequestSchema` first), the runtime dispatcher's twins (same schema on `POST`), declared `object_operation` endpoints, MCP `query`, action `callData('query')`, and server-built windows (import runner, connector pull, export loop: all integers).

| Schema (card's list and found) | Read by a door the normalizer judges? | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `FindDataRequestSchema` → `QueryWithTransportSchema` / `QueryTransportParamsSchema` (`limit`, `offset`, `top`, `$top`, `$skip`, `skip`) | yes, `POST /data/:object/query` and the dispatcher `POST` validate it | narrowed |
| `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` (`top`, `skip`) | describes `GET /data/:object` (no runtime parse; the SDK reads it as the declaration) | narrowed |
| `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` (`data-engine.zod.ts:111/114/117`) | no: `engine.find` options; no door parses it, `ObjectQL.find` does not validate windows, and in-process callers reach it without the normalizer | out of scope |
| `QuerySchema` (`limit` / `offset` / `top`) | only through the transport schema above, where the members are overridden; `QuerySchema` is also the driver contract and the recursive `expand` value, whose windows the normalizer never judges | not narrowed |
| `get_record.limit` (`builtin-node-config.zod.ts:628`) | no: the executor calls the `data` service (`ObjectQL`, `IDataEngine.find` / `findOne`), not `findData` | out of scope |
| `ListRecordResponseSchema.pagination` (`contract.zod.ts:445/446`) | no: a response, not a request window | out of scope |
| `AuditMetaItemRequest` / `HistoryMetaItemRequest` / `ListNotificationsRequest` `limit` (`protocol.zod.ts:1823/1921/3281`) | no: metadata audit/history and notification routes, not the data list doors | out of scope |
| `DataEngineFindRequestSchema` (RPC) | no reader outside the spec | out of scope |

So `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authored metadata window is judged by the normalizer, and the two narrowed schemas are request schemas. No migration line is owed for an authored flow `query` window: `get_record` never reaches the normalizer, so its `limit` is not narrowed here.

**Producer census** (fractional or negative windows): `examples/**` on this tree, no hit; HotCRM at `4166f2146bec`, 41 files name `get_record`, every literal `limit` is a positive integer (1, 500, 1000, and `BILLING_HANDOFF_LINE_ITEM_LIMIT = 200`), no fractional or negative window anywhere.

## One door answer moves: the code, not the verdict

`POST /data/:object/query` validates its body against `FindDataRequestSchema` before `findData`, so now that the schema declares the window, a malformed one is refused there: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[0].field` = `query.limit` / `query.offset`, where it was `400 INVALID_REQUEST` from the normalizer. It is still a 400 before any read, and it is the same answer the door already gave `{"limit":"ten"}`. The runtime dispatcher's `POST` twin moves the same way, by reading: it asks the same schema and answers `requestSchemaRefusal`, a `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `GET /data/:object` has no body schema and is byte-unchanged. Nothing newly refused, nothing newly accepted. `packages/rest/src/data-page-window-door.test.ts`'s `POST` pin is updated to assert this. See the open question in the report.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.page-window-declared.test.ts` (new). The oracle is the door: each value goes through the real `findData` with a recording engine (accepted iff the engine is reached; the window it receives is the expected parse output). 13 schema rows (`FindDataRequest` × 6 spellings, `QueryWithTransport` × 3, `HttpFindQueryParams` × 2, the two exported schemas) × 17 numbers, 18 strings and 3 other values (`-0`, `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` and one past it, `NaN`, `±Infinity`, `' 5 '`, `'1e2'`, `'0x10'`, blank, whitespace, `'-1'`, `'1.5'`, `true`, `{}`…). Every value the door refuses fails each schema's parse; every value it accepts passes with the same window. Number-only members (a JSON body's canonical keys) refuse every string, as before. 494 cases plus a non-vacuity check.
- `packages/spec/src/data/query-transport.test.ts`: number and digit windows that are not a count are refused on every spelling (digits at the canonical path naming the spelling, one diagnostic); `0` stays a window.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` refuses `-1`, `1.5`, blank, whitespace, `abc`; keeps `'0'` and `' 5 '`.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run mode, restored by blob): `limit` member back to `QuerySchema`'s → `query-transport.test.ts` 2 failed / 70 passed; the fold's string lowering back to "any finite number" → 4 failed / 68; `HttpFindQueryParams.top` back to `z.coerce.number()` → `protocol.test.ts` 4 failed / 191. Each restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Full suites, on the tree with `origin/main` at `bda53bb0b` merged, after building the dependency closure of `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/dogfood`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 709 files passed, 21545 tests passed, 1 todo (head `82fb363ac`).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 259 files passed, 3 skipped; 21410 tests passed, 19 skipped.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 316 files, 6327 passed, 326 skipped.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 435 files, 6885 passed, 19 skipped (an importer of `FindDataRequestSchema`).
  - `typecheck` exit 0 on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest`.
  - Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), as CI runs it, under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, 289 files passed and 3 skipped (292), 2491 tests passed and 18 skipped (2509). The packages were built at `685efa48` and the tree it ran on was `3fead31f3`. The commits after it add the `QueryPageWindowParsed` type alias (erased at run time), the dropped-refinements ledger header counts and regenerated JSON artifacts; none of them reaches a test at run time.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 114 families on this diff (the same 114 before and after merging main). All 114 ran, every final exit code is 0, recorded as `command :: exit code`, and `--ran` reconciled them: 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN ("a DERIVED zero — all 114 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3").
- Five needed a second run. Four were local prerequisites: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit, which was fetched), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3: packages with no `dist/` in this container, which were built), and `check:type-check-debt` (a 600 s local timeout while its closure build waited for the verify lock). One was a real finding: `check:spec-parsed-alias` (`QueryPageWindowSchema` had no `Parsed` alias, added in `3fead31f3`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date on the final tree. `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0 (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## Acceptance notes

- `QueryTransportParamsSchema` on its own still accepts any string on `$top` / `$skip` / `skip`: its digits are judged by the fold inside `QueryWithTransportSchema` (at the canonical path, naming the spelling, one diagnostic, the shape `query-transport.test.ts` already pins). No door parses the fragment alone.
- The JSON Schema for the string arm stays `string` (the refine is ledgered in `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`); the number arm publishes `integer`, `minimum 0`, `maximum 9007199254740991`.
- `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` still declares only `top` / `skip`, while the GET door also accepts `limit`, `offset`, `$top`, `$skip`. Declaring those would widen the schema, not this card.
- Nested `expand` windows and `engine.find` windows are not judged by the normalizer and stay as declared; a direct `engine.find` with `offset: -1` still meets the driver (PR #25260's acceptance note 2).
